provenance.author: OpenATCA contributors
provenance.reference: WGS-84 equatorial radius 6,378,137 m; rhumb inverse definition on the equator
provenance.method: At latitude zero the east-west rhumb follows the equator; length is a × π/180 for one degree and course is exactly east (90 degrees). Expected values use the published WGS-84 semi-major axis and mathematical conversion, not product output.
